title: Public-Participation Directory
description: Static reference directory of how the public weighs in on legislation in each U.S. jurisdiction (witness slip, Request to Speak, position letter, written testimony, public comment, etc.), with a link to the official portal. Consumed by docs/src/dashboard/index.html to show a 'how to weigh in — by state' directory alongside the live committee-hearings feed. Reference data, updated by hand as portals change — not scraped.

online.description: Whether participation can be done online.

how_to.description: One-sentence explanation of how a resident weighs in.
